name: Day-glo privacy noir
about: Style test B. Bright graphic comic art for a world of masks and disguises: noir framing with flat pure cyan and magenta instead of noir darkness. Described by its traits; no artist is named in the prompt.
prompt: Bold graphic comic art: confident clean black linework, flat pure saturated color with no gradients, a vivid palette of pure cyan, magenta and bright yellow against deep violet shadows, strong graphic shapes and silhouettes, dramatic noir camera angles but bright day-glo color, hoods, masks and disguises as a visual motif, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

settings.veridia: Day-glo greens and teal for the trees and stone, the violet of privacy robes standing out strongly.
settings.dzego: Electric magenta and cyan shop glow, yellow highlights, deep violet night shadows.
settings.united-cities: Cool cyan towers with magenta accents.
settings.arctic: Icy white and cyan with hard black shadows.
